(ja)༄༅/ /rta mgrin dmar po grub rgyal lugs kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /pad+ma kro dha na maḥsin+dhū'i lhun po'i spa

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rta mgrin dmar po grub rgyal lugs kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// pad+ma kro dha na maḥ sin+dhū'i lhun po'i spo la nyin byed kyis// lan brgyar byugs 'dra'i pad+ma dbang gi lha// rab 'jigs gshin rje khros pa'i gar mkhan po// khyod la dad pas snying nas phyag bgyid do// 'dir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi dpal rta mgrin dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba thob nas/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was chos thams cad stong par bsams la/ stong pa'i ngang las zla gam smug nag me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar nag bsam/ de las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas thod dbyug dkar po nam mkha' la 'phyar bas bgegs dang 'byung po ma lus pa 'joms par byed pa/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub bsgrengs pa las me 'bar bas gnod byed thams cad gzhob tu sreg pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig bgrad cing khro gnyer du bsdus pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gnag cing 'bar ba/ zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs shing rngams pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa'i gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs dkris pa/ klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par byas te brgyan pa/

sbom zhing thung la lto ba 'phyang ba/ gshin rje khros pa'i nyams can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bas bdud bzhi mnan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gar gyi nyams dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hrīḥyig dmar po sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng me 'bar ba klog pa'i tshul la sems gtad/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci nus bzlas/ 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na las thams cad 'grub par bshad/ de nas/ ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rta mchog sku// nyi ma'i 'od mtshungs nyon mongs sreg /bdud bzhi ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i// dpa' bo rta mgrin phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma bshams la/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pas zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu i daṃ ba liṃ ta a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod dang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// 'di'i byin rlabs byed par 'dod pas maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'am/ me tog gi tshom bu'i steng du/ dpal gtor rgyan ldan/ dar dmar po'i cod pan dang bcas pa mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor ba bsham/

gong bzhin bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ mdun gyi gtor ma rta mgrin du bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams bya/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod la/ maṇ+ḍal/ thun mong gi gsol gdab/ kun mkhyen ye shes tshigs bcad/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags rnams tshe dpag med kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya/ dngos gzhi la/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs/ lha dang sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa'o// dang po ni/ gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba'i dpral ba nas oṃ dkar po dpag med 'phros/ slob ma'i spyi bor thim pas lus gang*/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dang bar chad thams cad dag par bsams la/ rtsa sngags brjod cing rol mo bya/ de bzhin du/ mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ sngon po 'phros/ ngag dang yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gsung dang thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ re re la'ang rol mo sogs gong ltar bya/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor byon pa'i steng du rtsa brgyud bla ma/ mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo dpa' mo sprin 'thibs pa ltar bsams la/ gtor ma mgor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo sogs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi mtshan nas brjod cing*/ khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dus da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim pas/ slob ma rta mgrin dngos su gyur pa ni mngon rtogs ltar gsal gdab/

de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥdamar po gyen du langs par bsam/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar/ sngags phreng g.yas skor du gnas pa las/ de 'dra ba'i sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis kyi rnam par chad de slob ma'i snying gar g.yas skor du 'khod/ de yang dang po dam tshig pa/ gnyis pa ye shes pa/ gsum pa rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa'i tshul du bsams la/ rtsa sngags lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes dang*/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod/ rjes kyi yon 'bul ba sogs spyi ltar bya'o// pad+ma mthar byed khro bo yi// sgrub thabs byin rlabs cho gar bcas// grub pa'i rgyal mo'i gzhung bzhin du// gsal bar bgyis pa'i dge ba 'dis// bdud dpung mun rum mthar byas te// ye shes snang ba lam chen pos// bde ldan pad+ma kha phye ste// zung 'jug sbrang rtsir rol par shog /ces pa 'di yang rje btsun rdo ring pa'i gsung las skyes pa'i rgyal khams pas las dang po pa la phan pa'i phyir du sbyar ba'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rta mgrin dmar po grub rgyal lugs kyi byin rlabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ha ya grī bā ya/ dpal rta mgrin grub rgyal lugs kyi byin gyi rlabs pa'i cho ga la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ 'di'i byin rlabs thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i khar maṇ+ḍa lar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'am/ me tog gi tshom bu dgu bkod pa ni gdan mtshon byed dang*/ de'i steng du mañtsi'i khar lha bskyed gzhi dpal gtor dmar po rgyan ldan dar dmar po'i cod pan dang bcas pa bsham/

mdun du 'bul gtor zlum po dang*/ byang shar nas brtsams te mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis bskor/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril/ me tog gi snod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar byas te/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin nyams su blangs rjes/ mdun gyi gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zla gam smug nag sogs nas/ dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar rang nyid ces dor ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed ltar bskyed/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ha ya grī ba sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ hrīḥlas skyes pa'i sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs 'bul ba rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya/ mchod bstod kyi rjes su/ dpal chen rta mgrin 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ snod du rung ba'i slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul/ rang rang gi gral du snyims pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal 'debs sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ de la dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i snying rje chen po'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid gdul bya gdug cing gtum pa rnams rjes su bzung ba'i phyir dpal rta mgrin gyi skur bzhengs pa la/ rgyud dang man ngag rnams nas sgrub pa'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/

tshe gcig lus gcig kho nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang mngon sum du brnyes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ras chung rdo rje grags pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma grub pa'i rgyal mo las/ thugs rje chen po la brten nas byang chub sgrub pa/ tshe dpag med la brten nas tshe sgrub pa/ dpal rta mgrin la brten nas bar chad sel ba ste khyad par gyi gdams skor gsum gsan pa'i phyi ma/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i nang tshan rnal 'byor bla med ma rgyud pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs su gtogs pa dpal rta mgrin dmar po dpa' bo gcig pa'i byin rlabs rjes gnang gi rim pa zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su dpal rta mgrin la/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba til gyi gong bu kha bye ba bzhin mngon sum du khra lam mer bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rang dang gzhan gyi sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ de nas dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa ni 'di nyid kyi gzhung grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad pa las/ slob ma'i bar chad srung ba'i phyir/ gtor mas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsung thugs rnams bstim pa dang*// lha dang sngags kyi rjes gnang bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar thog mar sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi gtor ma 'di nyid dpal rta mgrin dngos su gsal ba'i dpral ba nas oṃ dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/

lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dag dpal rta mgrin gyi sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rtsa sngags brjod cing spos rol bya/ yang mdun bskyed kyi mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang bar chad thams cad dag dpal rta mgrin gyi gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol bya/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas hūm̐ sngon po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang bar chad thams cad dag dpal rta mgrin gyi thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol bya/ de nas lha dang sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du/ slob dpon la dpal rta mgrin dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po dung pa zhig mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon pa'i steng gi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ mtha' skor du yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams sprin 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs te rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ phag gru rdo rje rgyal po/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje/ thugs sras spyan snga rin ldan/ zur phug pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ 'bar ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ rtogs ldan rin chen 'phel/

'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rin chen mkhyen rab mchog grub/ kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ 'jam mgon dpal ldan chos skyong*/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po/ dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas dpal bzang po'i bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas de thams cad 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dpal rta mgrin gyi skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po nas/ bdud bzhi mnan pa/ zla gam smug nag me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la me phung 'bar ba'i dbus su gar gyi nyams dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po gyen du langs pa zhig gsal btab nas/ sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du/ slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du gnas pa las/

de 'dra ba'i sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis kyi rnam par lan gsum du chad de slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du bzhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar dang pos dam tshig pa'i tshul du 'khod/ gnyis pas ye shes pa'i tshul du thim/ gsum pas rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pa'i tshul gyis brtan par byas pa'i mos pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rtsa sngags lan gsum/ slar yang slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor bzhin pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags phreng brtan cing nus ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la dpal rta mgrin gyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig rjes gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ bdag bskyed la dmigs pa'i mchod bstod dang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dpal chen rta mgrin 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo smon dang*/ shis brjod spyi ltar bya'o// grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang gi rjes su 'di'i byin rlabs sbrel nas tshe rta zung 'brel ces bla ma rnams kyi phyag len du mdzad par snang ngo*// bsnyen pa byed na/

gnas dben par 'di nyid kyi bris sku yod na dgram pa'i mdun du/ 'bul gtor zlum po dang*/ mchod pa bsham/ bsnyen pa la 'jug pa'i tshul sogs bsnyen yig spyi ltar la/ tshad ni gzhung las/ 'bum du bzlas na las kun byed// ces 'byung bas thun bzhi'i rim pas grangs bsnyen rab 'bru 'bum ste 'bum phrag bco lnga/ 'bring 'bum phrag bzhi/ tha ma 'bum phrag gcig bzla/ dmigs pa gtso bor snying ga'i sngags phreng me 'bar bzhin pa la klog pa'i tshul du yid rtse gcig gtad/ skabs su sngags phreng las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus/ snying ga'i hrīḥl thim pas bdag nyid kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs te gzi brjid dang nus stobs mchog tu 'bar bar bsams la bzla/ thun thams cad kyi mjug tu mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ thun gnyis kyi mthar gtor ma 'bul/ de yang sgrub thabs kyi dkyus bshad pa ltar bdag bskyed la 'bul ba'am/ mdun bskyed la 'bul bar spro na/ byin rlabs kyi rjes su/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ gtor 'bul sogs dkyus ltar/ rjes lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol bya/

gnas gsum srung ba sogs sngar ltar ro// de ltar brtson pas bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis thob pa'i tshul brgyud ldan bla ma'i rnam thar las kyang mang du 'byung bas shes la/ las sbyor gyi bzlas pa byed par spro na/ bsnyen pa them nas/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod sogs gang 'dod par lcags kyus btab/ zhags pas bcings/ bdag gi mdun du bkug nas dbang du 'dus par bsams la rtsa sngags nyid bsnyen pa'i bcu cha tsam bzla bar gsungs/ gzhan las tshogs 'di nyid rang la dmigs bsal ma mthong yang*/ bsnyen pa them nas las thams cad byed par gsungs pas gsang ba spyi dang*/ bye brag rta mgrin gyi gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin ji ltar rigs pa bsgrub tu rung ba nyid do// zhes pa'ang rang gzhan la nye bar mkho ba'i slad/ rgya gzhung dang yig rnying dgongs don tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos legs par phye ba'i rjes su 'brangs te mang du thos pa'i bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs
